# Back-end functions generated by AI

Status: There is no business function at present, and no sample business service is created.
Establish a catalog according to the actual feature-id, corresponding to the function of the same name under front/features/. Each real service completes SERVICE.md, CONTRACT.md, DEPLOY.md, REFERENCES.md and ai-tasks/.
Each service is only responsible for its own business logic and data, and calls other services through an open contract. Data is partitioned by service in the application data/; private information is still in local-secrets/.
